claims.originalText: Art Institute of Chicago catalogues this object as "Pair of Cups".

claims.originalText: This catalogue material designation describes the recorded museum object; it is not a laboratory identification or an authentication of an unexamined collector object.

claims.originalText: Their floral medallions were delicately outlined in pale cobalt blue and, after glazing and firing, filled with soft, translucent enamels.

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

claims.originalText: Their style may reflect the influence of Japanese lacquers, which were imported into China in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries and subsequently inspired creative copies by Chinese palace craftsmen.

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

variants.text: Their style may reflect the influence of Japanese lacquers, which were imported into China in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries and subsequently inspired creative copies by Chinese palace craftsmen.
